reply_text: I replied to Ilse in her DM: Bay 30 is noted for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups. I told her I don't have private per-person memory. Anything I save long-term is shared across all my conversations, so I didn't save her note there, because it could come up in someone else's chat. Her note stays in our DM history, and I suggested a pinned note or her team's dock schedule if she wants it kept for good.
